Name.Description: The character's given name, typically in the format 'First Last'

Age.Description: The character's age in years. Subtracting this from Setting.Temporal.Current-Year yields the character's birth year

Height.Description: The character's height, expressed in the user's preferred unit

Hair-Colour.Description: The character's natural or current hair colour. Descriptive modifiers are encouraged (e.g. 'Chestnut Brown', 'Strawberry Blonde')

Top.Description: What the character is wearing on their upper body

Bottom.Description: What the character is wearing on their lower body

Mood.Description: The character's dominant emotional state at this moment in the narrative

Name.Description: The user's name as they prefer to be addressed by the character

Current-Year.Description: The year in which the narrative is currently set

Name.Description: The name of the current location (e.g. 'Chicago Memorial Hospital', 'The Crown pub')

Space.Description: Whether the scene takes place inside a building or outdoors

Description.Description: A brief description of the immediate surroundings and atmosphere
